titulo_pagina: Dixi Tower — local control tower for coding agents
descripcion: Live view of the local development agents: what each one is working on, its branch, progress and latest action.
subtitulo: Local development agents, one per project
sin_conexion: Lost connection to the dashboard. It retries on its own every few seconds; if it does not come back, start it with: dixi-tower panel
vacio: No agents launched yet. Launch one with: dixi-tower lanzar <project> <st-id>
pantalla_vacia: This agent is off. You can turn it back on or delete it; deleting removes its worktree and keeps its branch.
solo_lectura: This dashboard only listens on your machine (127.0.0.1). What you type here goes to the agent's console as is.
escribir: Type an instruction for the agent, or / to see its commands. Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a line break.
filtro: Search by project, task or id…
elige: Pick an agent from the list.
sugerida: {texto}   ⇥ Tab to use this suggestion from the agent
teclado: Keyboard: with the box empty, ↑ ↓ Enter and Esc go straight to the agent, and Tab takes its suggestion. When the agent needs you, 1, 2 and 3 pick the menu option.
nuevo_nota: A new branch and worktree are created for the project. The agent runs on your subscription and ends with a pull request; it never merges or deploys.
instruccion_ayuda: Required when no board task is picked; optional otherwise.
forzar: Launch even if the project is over its in-review limit
error_lanzar: The agent could not be launched.
error_reanudar: The operation could not be completed.
autonomia_ayuda: Supervised: asks before editing and before running anything outside its allowed list. Balanced: edits without asking and checks in for commands outside the list. Autonomous: decides on its own and asks as little as possible. At every level it never merges, deploys or reads secrets.
subagentes_cuantos: Maximum subagents open at a time (1 to 20)
limites_ayuda: When your account usage reaches the given percentage, the agent stops working and tells you. 0 means no limit. Usage is account-wide: every agent shares it.
tope_alcanzado: This agent stopped at its usage limit: {motivo}. Raise the limit in Settings to let it continue.
ajustes_nota: Limits and subagents apply right away. Engine and autonomy apply the next time you turn this agent on.
config_nota: Values every new agent starts with. Existing agents keep their own; change those in their Settings.
error_config: The settings could not be saved.
uso_codex: not available with Codex; shown in the footer of its console
codex_nota: With Codex: its sandbox protects .git, so in supervised and balanced it asks you to approve each commit, and in autonomous an automatic reviewer approves it. Usage limits cannot be enforced yet, the subagent cap applies when the agent is turned on, and its status in the list is approximate.
